fields.label: Offer Name
fields.description: What the gym calls it — "New Year 20%", "Founding Member Rate". Members see this on their membership.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: The offer in plain words, for whoever grants it at the desk.

fields.label: Ended
fields.description: Ends the offer now. Memberships already on it keep the rate they were given — ending an offer never re-prices anyone.

fields.label: Discount Value
fields.description: The % (e.g. 20) or the amount (e.g. 1000) off this member's price.

fields.label: Applies To
fields.options:
First invoice only
Every invoice
Until the offer ends
fields.description: 'First invoice only' is a joining offer; 'Every invoice' is a grandfathered rate the member keeps; 'Until the offer ends' expires on the offer's end date.

fields.label: Runs From
fields.description: The offer can only be given to a member between these dates.

fields.label: Runs Until
fields.description: Leave blank for an offer with no end date.

fields.label: Limit
fields.description: How many members may be given this offer in total. 0 = no limit (e.g. 'first 50 members').
Give the offer a code and it stops appearing in the enrolment list — a member has to know the code to get it. Leave blank for an offer the desk simply gives out.
fields.label: Coupon Code

fields.description: What the member types or quotes, e.g. FIT50. Case does not matter — it is stored in capitals.
fields.label: Code

fields.description: How many times ONE member may use this offer. 0 = no per-member limit. The overall Limit above still applies.
fields.label: Limit Per Member
Branch
fields.description: Leave blank to run the offer at every branch.

fields.label: Plans
fields.description: Leave empty to run the offer on every plan.
